details:
VRChat clients may not receive synchronized data about queue status or information about leaving a queue even after refreshing instance details, leaving clients with stale cached data about queue status in memory until restart.

1. Launch a VRChat client.

2. Queue to a full Group Public/Group+/Group instance.

3. Launch a second VRChat client using `launch.exe` from the VRChat install directory, login with the same account.

4. In the second client, leave the queue to the full Group Public/Group+/Group instance.

5. Wait for the instance to become empty. (Several hours later.)

6. In the first client, open Quick Menu, click on "Instance Queue" text to view the instance details.

Expected result: Leave the queue in all clients.

Actual result: Instance is displayed to be empty (0/10 users), 1/1 queued in a client.

I was unable to determine if the server is still reporting queued 1/1 or if it's client-side stale data only.

`grp_646628f9-7df2-475d-997b-2052cf88ec89`, `wrld_0fb88df3-2057-4c2f-8e06-e948864378fd`, US West, Group+. Instance ID #676767?

A partial log file is available and attached, for environment information only.
title: Queued 1/1 into an empty 0/10 Group+ instance hours later (stale cached data)
